description: Run Codex as a managed external operation in the runtime workspace or an explicitly configured allowed project root. op:start detaches the worker and completes through the runtime's bus completion contract; op:status inspects a worker's local state; op:abort kills the worker and terminalizes its operation.

op_id.description: Worker identifier from a prior start (its op_id), for abort or status.

cwd.description: Existing working directory relative to the selected root. Absolute paths, empty components, dot-dot traversal, and symlink escape are rejected.

root.description: Working-root selector for start. Defaults to workspace. Project requires actions.manage_codex.allowed_project_root.

permission_mode.description: Permission mode for this start. Defaults to safe and cannot exceed the deployment's actions.manage_codex.max_permission_mode ceiling.
